stem.en: Carbon-12 has 6 protons and 6 neutrons. Carbon-14 is a rarer, heavier form found in small amounts in everything living. Which is true of carbon-14?

text.en: It has 6 protons and 8 neutrons. It is still carbon, and it does the same chemistry.

feedback.en: Eight protons is oxygen, not carbon. Only neutrons can be added without changing the element.
Seven protons is nitrogen. Carbon must keep its six protons whatever else changes.
The name follows the protons. Six protons is carbon, at any weight.

explanation.en: Mass number 14 minus atomic number 6 leaves 8 neutrons. The extra two neutrons change the mass and nothing about the chemistry.
